title: Randomized Acceptance Probability with No Coins
statement: For every decidable predicate $A$ on bit strings, the probability that $A$ holds on a uniformly random bit string of length zero equals $1$ if $A$ holds on the empty string, and equals $0$ otherwise.
hypotheses_covered: $A$ is a predicate on bit strings
